comments: Tests whether kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_oracle_damp_kernel3_finetune_dropout.json's 0.4821 val dice ceiling was a real training-time benefit or just an artifact of evaluating on the same privileged (ground-truth-cleaned) distribution it trained on. Dataset here (kurals/dataset_process/build_mixed_train_dataset.py) uses the oracle-damped transform ONLY for the Train split's 2064 frames -- legitimate use of labels available during training -- while Validation/Test stay on the realistic, deployable plain-max-pooled distribution (identical to the KuRALS_CW_8x64_kernel3_finetune_dropout.json baseline's 0.3757/0.3635). If val/test dice here lands near 0.3757, the oracle result doesn't transfer -- the model just overfit to spotting the artificially flat oracle background, not to detecting real targets under realistic noise. If it clears 0.3757 meaningfully, training-time-only privileged cleaning is a real, deployable technique (no oracle/ground truth needed at inference, only during training set construction).
